title: Exotic Crunchy Algerian Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful and crunchy post-workout dish featuring lamb and shortcrust pastry, served in a Korean brass bowl. This Whole30-friendly recipe combines the spices of Algeria with the convenience of a ssam-wrap.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the lamb until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to the oven and roast for 20 minutes, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the shortcrust pastry and cut into 4-6 rectangles, depending on the size of the ssam leaves.
Spread a layer of Dijon mustard on each pastry rectangle, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Slice the roasted lamb into thin strips and place on top of the mustard.
Place a ssam leaf on top of the lamb and fold the pastry into a wrap.
Serve the wraps in a Korean brass bowl and enjoy.
Garnish with additional sumac and salt, if desired.
